name: ☕️ Buna
overview: Freshly roasted organic beans brewed in a traditional jebena, offering a rich aroma and bold, authentic flavor.

name: 🍲 Shiro
overview: A smooth, slow-cooked chickpea flour stew spiced with berbere, garlic, and herbs, served hot with soft injera.

name: 🍝 Pasta
overview: Tossed in a savory homemade tomato sauce with mild Ethiopian spices and herbs for a comforting fusion dish.

name: 🫖 Tea
overview: Steeped black tea infused with warm spices like cinnamon and cardamom, perfect for a cozy afternoon break.

name: 🍚 Rice
overview: Fluffy steamed rice stir-fried with fresh garden vegetables, light spices, and a touch of vegetable oil.

name: 🍗 Doro Wat
overview: Ethiopia’s signature celebratory dish featuring tender chicken simmered in a deep, fiery berbere sauce with hard-boiled eggs.

name: 🥘 Firfir
overview: Shredded pieces of soft injera soaked in a rich, tangy berbere and spiced butter reduction.

name: 🥐 Baklava
overview: Crisp layers of flaky phyllo dough stuffed with chopped nuts and drenched in sweet honey syrup.

name: 🍰 Milifoni
overview: A delicate, multi-layered puff pastry filled with smooth pastry cream and dusted with powdered sugar.
